description: Resolves a Crossref member ID to its publisher/organization record: primary name, alternate imprint names, owned DOI prefixes, registered DOI counts, a per-work-type breakdown, and per-category metadata deposit coverage. Members are the organizations that register DOIs with Crossref, so this answers "what does this publisher publish, and how completely do they deposit metadata?" Resolve a DOI prefix (e.g. "10.1038") to its member ID with crossref_get_prefix, then pass that ID here.

member_id.description: Crossref member ID — a positive integer, e.g. 297 (Springer) or 340 (PLOS). Resolve a DOI prefix to a member ID first with crossref_get_prefix.

name: crossref_get_member

backfileDois.description: DOIs registered in the backfile (older) window

currentDois.description: DOIs registered in the current (recent) window

totalDois.description: Total DOIs registered by this member (current + backfile)

coverage.description: Per-category metadata deposit coverage — each a 0–1 fraction split into current (recent) and backfile (older) DOIs. Signals how completely this publisher deposits references, abstracts, ORCIDs, funders, licenses, and similar metadata.

items.description: Metadata deposit coverage for one category

deposits.description: Whether the member deposits any metadata with Crossref

depositsArticles.description: Whether the member deposits journal-article metadata

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: Crossref answered HTTP 429 and the limit did not clear inside the retry budget. `upstream_unavailable`: Crossref was unreachable, returned a 5xx status, or served an HTML error page instead of JSON. `malformed_response`: Crossref returned HTTP 200 with a body that is not valid JSON. `request_timeout`: Crossref did not respond within CROSSREF_TIMEOUT_MS, or answered HTTP 408/504. `member_not_found`: No Crossref member exists for the given ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

names.description: Alternate and imprint names registered under this member

prefixes.description: DOI prefixes owned by this member, e.g. "10.1038"

worksByType.description: DOI counts broken down by work type (all DOIs), sorted by count descending

items.description: DOI count for one work type

count.description: Number of DOIs of this type registered by the member

title: Get Member by ID
